## 3. Detailed Project Portfolio

### Project 1: ByaHero — Public Transportation Tracking System
- **Role:** Full-Stack Developer & UI/UX Designer
- **Period:** 2025 – 2026
- **Architecture & Technologies:**
  - Frontend: Semantic HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), Bootstrap 5, responsive layouts.
  - Mobile Layer: CapacitorJS cross-platform packaging with Android runtime support.
  - State & Sync: Resilient AJAX polling mechanism for near-instant vehicle status updates and seat availability tracking without persistent WebSocket overhead.
  - UI/UX: Fully prototyped and wireframed in Figma before frontend implementation.
  - Device Features: Geolocation tracking, persistent background location reporting, native notifications.
- **Problem Solved:** Addresses commuter uncertainty in public transport routes by delivering real-time vehicle locations and occupancy status to waiting passengers.

### Project 2: SnapEat — AI-Powered Food & Nutrition Scanner
- **Role:** Full-Stack Developer & AI Integrator
- **Period:** 2026
- **Architecture & Technologies:**
  - Backend: Python, Flask REST application.
  - AI & Vision: Google Cloud Vision API (optical character recognition and label extraction), Google Gemini API (multimodal dish classification and macro-nutrient synthesis).
  - Storage Layer: Dual-engine support for SQLite (local rapid testing) and PostgreSQL (production data persistence).
  - Client: Clean, responsive web interface for camera image capture and instant nutrient calculation.
- **Problem Solved:** Simplifies nutritional tracking by enabling users to photograph a meal or nutrition label and receive immediate macronutrient and caloric estimates.

### Project 3: Marvel Cinematic Universe Web App
- **Role:** Frontend Developer
- **Technologies:** Next.js, React, Modern CSS, Responsive Design.
- **Description:** An interactive web portal cataloging Marvel Cinematic Universe timeline releases, character profiles, and media relationships with rich interactive components.

## 4. Technical Skillset & Tooling Taxonomy

### Cybersecurity & Defense Methodologies
- **Offensive Security & Pen-Testing:** Penetration testing workflows, TryHackMe and HackTheBox practice, CTF challenge solving.
- **Vulnerability Remediation:** OWASP Top 10 web vulnerabilities mitigation (SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF), Insecure Direct Object References).
- **Network Analysis:** Wireshark packet capture, protocol inspection (TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS), firewall fundamentals.
- **Security Environments:** Kali Linux, command-line utilities, basic bash scripting for security automation.

### Web & Software Development
- **Languages:** JavaScript (ES6+), Python 3, C++, PHP, HTML5, CSS3.
- **Frontend Frameworks:** React, Next.js, Bootstrap 5.
- **Backend & APIs:** Python Flask, PHP (XAMPP environment), RESTful API development.
- **Mobile Development:** CapacitorJS cross-platform web-to-mobile packaging.
- **Databases:** MySQL, SQLite, PostgreSQL, Google Firebase Firestore.
- **Version Control & CI/CD:** Git, GitHub repository management.
